component.name: Meridian
component.summary: A calm, private calendar for your day

description.p: Meridian is a fast, beautiful calendar that keeps your schedule on your own computer. There are no accounts, no tracking and no network access.

ul.li: Day, week, month and agenda views
Drag to create, move and resize events
Repeating events with “only this one” or “all future” edits
Desktop reminders, even when the window is closed
Colour-coded calendars, fast search and undo

description.p: Fixes a freeze when clicking an event’s start or end time. The header adapts to narrower windows.
Works on Ubuntu 24.04 without sudo (AppArmor profile for the WebKit sandbox). Click anywhere in the calendar to create an event.
